info.sub_name: 大學精進英文(二)中高級

description.sub_name: 大學精進英文(二)中高級
description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others.

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

textBooks.tpb_book: Blass, Laurie, Mari Vargo, and Kristin Johannsen. Pathways 2: Reading, Writing, and Critical Thinking. 3rd ed.,           National Geographic Learning, 2025.

readings.tpc_book: Blass, Laurie, Mari Vargo, and Kristin Johannsen. Pathways 2: Reading, Writing, and Critical Thinking. 3rd ed.,           National Geographic Learning, 2025.

weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Midterm Exam : Group Presentations from Units 8-9

gradeRules.evalb_memo:
平時考核 (In-class evaluation): 
1. 隨堂考試(quiz): 15%
2. 課堂討論(discussion): 15%
3. 作文 (Essay):10%
4. 出席 (Attendance): 10%
5. 多益後測 (TOEIC Post-test): 10%

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Any use of earphones during class time is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Each use will lead to 5 points deducted from the semester grade. 上課中，耳機的使用是嚴格禁止的．違者每一次扣總成績五分．
2. Be on time. 請準時上課。
3. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
4. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected durati on.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
5. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
6. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
7. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
8. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. 學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。  
2.Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism. 抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。  
3.Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating. 考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
